remove_evidence_spans: In order to fill in this gap, we study in this work thermodynamic, structural and elastic properties of interfaces between these two phases

update.evidence_span: the uniaxial deformation (OUD) leads to nearly identical values of all three normal stresses, i.e., σ x = σ y = σ ax , means that the loading is almost hydrostatic
update.content: The OUD loading path produces a nearly hydrostatic stress state.

add.content: Common LDA and PBE calculations do not reproduce the observed Fe3Al ground state.
add.evidence_span: neither LDA nor PBE parametrization of GGA can correctly reproduce the D0 3 structure as the ground state of Fe 3 Al

add.content: Softening elastic constants produce mechanical instability before the nominal strength maximum.
add.evidence_span: mechanical stability is strongly affected by softening of elastic constants C ′ and/or C 66 and by corresponding elastic instabilities

add.content: The disordered Fe-Al phase is the weak point governing nanocomposite tensile failure.
add.evidence_span: the disordered Fe-Al phase represents the weakest point of the studied nanocomposite in terms of tensile loading

add.content: Under OUL loading, Fe3Al tensile strength is only 4.1 GPa.
add.evidence_span: the related tensile strength ( σ ts OUL = 4.1 GPa), i.e., only 17 % of the value found in the case of the OUD model

add.content: The defect-free calculations may overestimate strength because phonon effects were omitted.
add.evidence_span: quantum-mechanical phonon calculations, which can assess temperature effect, are computationally very demanding and, therefore, we leave it for future studies
